notes.title: ♟️ New Update & 5 Years of BOT.vinnik! ♟️
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow chess enthusiasts![/p][p][/p][p]Last week marked [b]5 years[/b] since the launch of the first game in our BOT.vinnik franchise! To celebrate this special milestone and reinforce our commitment to the series, we've released a new update for [b]BOT.vinnik Chess: Combination Lessons[/b], featuring several enhancements inspired by our latest project, [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b] (available now for wishlist!)[/p][p][/p][h3]Check out what's new:[/h3][list][*][p]🔊 [b]New BOT.vinnik Reactions:[/b] We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.[/p][/*][*][p]✏️ [b]Comprehensive Text Revision:[/b] Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]Windowed Mode:[/b] You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing [b]ALT + ENTER[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]📈 [b]Gameplay Flow Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.[/p][/*][*][p]Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Minor Visual Refinements:[/b] Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 [b]New Splash Screen:[/b] Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]New Game: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy![/h2][p]Excited about these updates? There's something even bigger on the horizon! The demo for our latest project, [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b], is almost ready, and you can already add it to your wishlist on Steam:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Your support means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the incredible 5 years, here's to many more.[/p][p]— Deep Green Games Team.[/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It's been a month since launch, and we are thrilled with the reception the game has had so far! Even our charming instructor is grateful!
As a way to thank all of you for the incredible support, we are releasing a major game update, containing:

- Achievements (everyone likes achievements, right? Or so we've heard)!
- 50% more content and TWO more chapters with brand new tactical themes.
- support for macOS! (included in the last few weeks)

We hope you like it and keep studying chess while having fun!

One last thing:
There's more BOT.vinnik on the way! Stay tuned!
